The desktop app runs on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows (x64 and Arm64), and Linux (x64 and Arm64). The phone app runs on iPhone and Android with the same account and cloud computer as desktop. The desktop and mobile apps are thin clients for chat, review, and approvals.

Cursor manages model selection with no customer-facing model picker. Usage analytics show the model that served each request, including failovers, and billing follows the serving model.

cells.value: Grok Bot runs only on Cursor-hosted cloud computers, and the computers Bots work on run in Cursor's cloud. On-premises deployment, deployment inside your own perimeter, and bring-your-own-image deployment are not supported today.

Grok Bot uses your Cursor account. There is no separate Grok Bot login. Access is included on every paid individual Cursor plan and on Cursor Teams, and usage can also be granted by linking an individual SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy, or X Premium+ subscription.

All of a user's Bots use the same cloud computer, sharing its files, browser sessions, and app logins. Each user's work executes on a dedicated cloud computer in Cursor's cloud, and each team member gets one hosted computer where every Bot they run does its work.
